QuestInfo.name: Path of Harmony
QuestInfo.0: The moment you met Eto and talked about Rami, smoke started to rise from the forest. What's going on?
QuestInfo.1: The moment you met Eto and talked about Rami, smoke started to rise from the forest. What's going on?
QuestInfo.2: Eto's determination calmed the vengeance of Rami. Following that, Ropa decided it was best to sweep the whole incident under the rug. May the Anima of Carcion walk on the path of harmony from this day forward.
